usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF)
usdRate.note: The US dollar is the official currency of the FSM.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: IMF World Economic Outlook (October 2026 database), CPI inflation, average
inflation_cpi.note: 2.8% for 2025 (5.4% in 2024); IMF forecasts 3.2% for 2026 and ADB 3.8% (ADO September 2026). The national statistics site was not reachable.

inflation_projection.sourceName: US dollar economy (Federal Reserve 2% target); IMF WEO 5-year CPI average
inflation_projection.note: The FSM uses the US dollar; CPI averaged about 4.2% in 2021-2025 because of imported food and fuel, and the IMF expects 2-3% later, so we plan with 3%.

policy_rate.note: The FSM has no central bank or monetary policy of its own; it uses the US dollar.

savings_account_rate.note: Bank deposit rate pages for the FSM were not reachable; see bank_deposit_avg_rate for the average paid on deposits.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month time deposit rate found for banks in the FSM.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year time deposit rate found for banks in the FSM.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product or rate found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: FDIC call report data, interest on deposits / total deposits of the FSM-chartered commercial bank
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: US$1.38 million of interest on about US$236 million of deposits in 2025 (about 0.58%); World Bank FR.INR.DPST shows 0.04% for 2021. Computed by us from the FDIC figures.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The FSM government sells no savings certificates or retail savings bonds.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The FSM government issues no treasury bills.

tbond_5y_rate.note: The FSM government issues no tradable bonds.

tbond_10y_rate.note: The FSM government issues no tradable bonds.

tax_bank_interest.note: FSM national taxes are on wages and business gross revenue; we could not read an official page confirming the treatment of individuals' interest income (the Department of Finance tax pages give no detail).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: FDIC standard deposit insurance amount; FDIC institution data lists the banks operating in the FSM as FDIC-insured
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Both commercial banks with branches in the FSM are FDIC-insured (FDIC BankFind data, state code FM), so deposits are covered up to US$250,000 per depositor per bank per ownership category.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity index in US dollars
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held in dollars over a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Average deposit rate (0.58%) plus a 4-point equity premium; global index in US dollars
equity_return_base.note: There is no stock market in the FSM, so equity means a global index in US dollars, capped at the safe deposit rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Long-run global equity returns in US dollars
equity_return_high.note: High case close to the long-run nominal return of global equities in dollars.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold price trend; the FSM uses the US dollar
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade in dollar terms and there is no currency depreciation to add.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold price trend; the FSM uses the US dollar
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year, with no exchange-rate effect because the US dollar is the local currency.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold price trend; the FSM uses the US dollar
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case near savings-account rates. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case just under the 0.58% average paid on deposits. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case for longer time deposits on larger balances. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No insurance regulator publication with a claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates or premium guides for the FSM found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major hospital stay found; serious cases are often referred off-island.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age found; the MiCare plan page was not reachable (expired certificate).

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)
oop_health_share.note: 2.6% in 2023; public and donor-funded care covers most costs.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: IMF WEO CPI; no published medical CPI
goal_inflation_health.note: No health price index is published, so we plan one point above general inflation for medical costs, including off-island referrals.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: IMF WEO CPI; no published education CPI
goal_inflation_education.note: No education price index is published, so we plan one point above general inflation, as for US-priced tuition.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: No life table by age found for the FSM (georank.org has no FSM page; the WHO GHO API was unavailable).

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 9.9 in 2025 (World Bank), 11.6 in 2040 and 16.9 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: FSM Social Security Administration, retirement benefits
retirement_age_default.note: Full old-age benefit at 65; a reduced benefit (50%) can be taken from 60. Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.note: No mandatory retirement age for FSM national government employees found; public employees are covered by the same Social Security scheme.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case near savings-account rates. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case just under the 0.58% average paid on deposits, the only local safe rate. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Average interest paid on deposits (FDIC call reports)
retirement_return_high.note: High case for longer time deposits on larger balances. Safe USD rates in the FSM: no treasury bills or savings bonds are issued; interest paid on deposits at the FSM-chartered bank averaged about 0.58% in 2025 (FDIC call reports); no tax on interest found.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of US-dollar deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% global equity at the low case, 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of US-dollar deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half global equity at 4.5% and half deposits at 0.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of US-dollar deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% global equity at the high case and 40% deposits.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension found; the Department of Health and Social Affairs lists elderly services but no cash allowance.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or severance law for private employees found.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: FSM Social Security Administration, benefits and FAQ
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory social security: 7.5% employee + 7.5% employer on wages up to US$7,000 a quarter; full benefit at 65 (50% from 60) after 50 quarters; annual benefit 16.5% of the first US$10,000 of cumulative covered earnings, 3% of the next US$30,000, 2% of the next US$262,500, 1% above; minimum US$100 a month. No automatic cost-of-living adjustment is described.

fdr_3m.note: Offered by banks in the FSM; no published rate found.

fdr_1y.note: Offered by banks in the FSM; no published rate found.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond.

tbill_91d.note: The FSM government issues no treasury bills.

tbond_5y.note: The FSM government issues no bonds.

tbond_10y.note: The FSM government issues no bonds.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange or locally offered retail funds; global funds are only reachable through overseas accounts.

gold.note: Legal to hold, but there is no local bullion market; gold is mostly bought abroad.

publicHealthCover.name: FSM Department of Health and Social Affairs (public hospitals; MiCare plan for public employees)

depositInsurance.name: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC)
depositInsurance.note: Banks operating in the FSM are FDIC-insured.
